speaker: (the gunner)
text: I have heard enough of short loaves. A man who doubts this chart is no friend to the voyage, and no friend to the Queen who blessed it. That is disloyalty, and I will say so in a public room.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I doubted the count. I did not doubt a queen I have not heard, and I am not your recruit.

speaker: george_bryan
text: He asked for a weight. You gave him a sin. Those are different coins.

speaker: will_kemp
text: And I asked, still with respect, why the chart was in Bishopsgate. If respect is disloyalty, the word has had a long day.

speaker: alice_brambleby
text: Out. The chart with you. Doubt is not disloyalty at this board, and a customer's doubt is not a treason for me to punish.

speaker: (the gunner)
text: You will be sorry when the pots come home gold.

speaker: alice_brambleby
text: I will be here, at sixpence, whether they do or they do not. The door is behind your elbow. Take the grease with you.

speaker: will_kemp
text: There. Bishopsgate has one less fleet in it. I am almost fond of the lane.

speaker: george_bryan
text: He will tell it better at the next house. The distance will have improved it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Let him. I have the beef, and I have forty, and I have not got a rain. I am not going after the chart.

speaker: alice_brambleby
text: Sit down. Your sixpence is still a supper. I will not have the room finish his argument for him.
